mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals monetary easing, which lowers discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4% signals improving labor market conditions, reducing risk premium pressures and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE remaining below 4% for the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (GDP growth) and HOUST (industrial production) indicate robust demand-side expansion, which strengthens equity valuations and drives positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising, or one proxy falls while the other rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates amplifies the positive impact on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining, or the regime ends before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4% signals improving labor market conditions, reducing risk premium pressures and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE remaining below 4% for the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (GDP growth) and INDPRO (industrial production) indicate robust demand-side expansion and supply-side strength, which strengthens equity valuations and drives positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising, or one proxy falls while the other rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS rates signals higher discount rates, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or the tightening cycle ends before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above 95 indicates robust supply-side growth, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 95.
